verdict.rationale: Flutterwave publishes an official Postman collection for its v3 API, which is a machine-readable description of the API and a plausible OpenAPI equivalent. However, probes of all standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, and the docs frame the collection as an exploration tool rather than a downloadable spec. The llms.txt and docs.md files are documentation indexes, not API specifications. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, an explicit download path for a machine-readable spec, schema-level completeness and versioning details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The [postman collection](https://www.postman.com/lively-zodiac-773579/flutterwave-api/collection/9qa6trt/flutterwave-v3) is a great way to quickly explore our APIs without writing code.
